name: China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in Dalian, China, China Catalyst Holding Co., Ltd., established in 2008, is actively engaged in the research, development, production, and global distribution of zeolite catalysts, tailored process solutions, and various fine chemicals. The company, formerly known as Dalian Heterogeneous Catalyst Co., Ltd. until its rebranding in November 2015, serves the environmental protection, energy, and chemical industries. Its extensive product portfolio includes specialized molecular sieves and a wide array of catalysts such as those used for hydrogen peroxide to propylene oxide (HPPO), epichlorohydrin (POCL), high-purity methanol, hydrogenation of dimethyl oxalate to ethylene glycol (DEG), ammoximation, pyridine, medical oxygen production (via zeolite adsorbents), and isomerization. Furthermore, China Catalyst supplies fine chemical compounds like tetrapropylammonium hydroxide, N,N,N-trimethyl-1-ammonium adamantine, and isopentenyl alcohol.
